nodes.label: Home (Customizable New Tab)
nodes.author: Malik
nodes.rationale: Clean, fully customizable Chrome New Tab start page — no branding, no clutter, everything stays on your machine.

nodes.label: background.js
nodes.rationale: Single-home-window behavior: opening a new tab focuses the existing Home tab instead of duplicating.

nodes.label: Auto-Restore
nodes.rationale: State mirrors to chrome.storage.local; if local data is cleared or corrupt it restores automatically.

nodes.label: Bookmarks Import
nodes.rationale: Bookmarks imported automatically on first launch; re-import anytime; only new pins are added, duplicates skipped.

nodes.label: Local Persistence (localStorage / chrome.storage.local)
nodes.rationale: All data stays local (localStorage / chrome.storage.local); the only network requests are favicon images, user-added media, and the default wallpaper. Privacy-first, no-branding design.

nodes.label: Custom Pin Grid
nodes.rationale: Adjustable tile width (4–20 columns per row), up to 50 pins per tab; bare domains are auto-normalized (youtube.com → https://www.youtube.com/).

nodes.label: Daily Quote Widget (dummyjson.com)
nodes.rationale: Random quote from a free public API (dummyjson.com) with an offline fallback.

nodes.label: Search Engine Configuration
nodes.rationale: Bare domains work as engine URLs (https:// added automatically); defaults include Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, Brave, Yahoo, Wikipedia, GitHub, Stack Overflow, MDN.

nodes.label: Settings Panel
nodes.rationale: Theme-aware right-side panel with no scrollbars; opens via gear (hidden until hover); position selectable with live preview.

nodes.label: Todo Widget
nodes.rationale: Notebook-style task list with hand-drawn checkboxes and animated strike-through; movable via position sliders; off by default.

nodes.label: Toolbar Icon
nodes.rationale: Clicking the extension toolbar icon opens Home in a new tab and reloads the extension (it never disables itself).

nodes.label: UI Fonts
nodes.rationale: 26 UI fonts: 6 built-in plus custom fonts by name/family or uploaded .ttf/.otf/.woff/.woff2; can be applied to every website in Chrome (enabled by default).

nodes.label: Wallpapers with Auto Theme
nodes.rationale: 32 built-in wallpapers that auto-apply a matching color scheme; the default wallpaper's URL stays hidden until you add your own.

nodes.label: Weather Widget (weatherapi.com)
nodes.rationale: Powered by weatherapi.com (free plan); data cached 30 minutes to respect free call limits; embedded WEATHER_KEY can be replaced at the top of app.js.

nodes.label: Symbolic reading: doorway/home motif consistent with the 'Home' browser-extension (customizable new-tab start page) branding
nodes.norm_label: symbolic reading: doorway/home motif consistent with the 'home' browser-extension (customizable new-tab start page) branding

nodes.label: Visual composition: transparent background, rounded-square tile filled with a blue gradient (indigo #637efb to cyan #36b9f2), with a near-white/light arch-shaped glyph centered near the lower-middle
nodes.norm_label: visual composition: transparent background, rounded-square tile filled with a blue gradient (indigo #637efb to cyan #36b9f2), with a near-white/light arch-shaped glyph centered near the lower-middle

nodes.label: Manifest declaration of icon32.png as extension action/page icon
